description: This file implements the Ocdm class and the OcdmFactory class within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It manages creation and access to Ocdm instances and checks support for specific media key types using external OpenCDM functions.

classes.name: OcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing singleton instances of IOcdm.

classes.name: Ocdm
classes.description: Class providing media key support functionalities, such as checking if a key system type is supported.

methods.name: IOcdmFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IOcdmFactory instance.

methods.name: OcdmFactory::getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IOcdm instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Ocdm::isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system type is supported by invoking external OpenCDM functions.
